agent_runs.node_description: Fetch usage metrics, NPS scores, support data for customer accounts
Apply weighted churn model, classify accounts by risk level
Write personalized CSM emails for critical and at-risk accounts
Check factual accuracy, tone, duplicate prevention, business rule compliance
_prosecutor_faults: RULE 4: Draft 1 (VoltDesk) — subject line states '8 tickets are still open' but research data shows 8 of 9 open tickets, not 8 total open. Phrasing is ambiguous and could be interpreted as only 8 tickets exist when 9 were submitted.

RULE 4: Draft 2 (NovaWorks) — body states '14 support tickets in the last 30 days' which matches research (tickets_30d: 14), but does not clarify how many are open. Research shows 6 open tickets but draft does not mention this critical detail.
RULE 4: Draft 3 (ClearSolutions) — body states '6 support tickets still open' but research data shows tickets_30d: 7 with open_tickets: 6. Draft should clarify '6 of 7' to match research accuracy.

RULE 4: Draft 4 (PeakSolutions) — body states 'all 10 support tickets resolved' but research data shows tickets_30d: 10 with open_tickets: 0. While technically accurate (0 open = all resolved), the phrasing 'all 10 support tickets resolved' could mislead reader into thinking all 10 were resolved recently when they may have been resolved at different times.

RULE 4: Draft 5 (BoldConnect) — body states '4 support tickets still open' which matches research (open_tickets: 4), but does not mention total tickets_30d: 12. Draft should clarify '4 of 12' for full context.

RULE 3: Draft 3 (ClearSolutions) — tone uses phrase 'I'll be honest' which, while conversational, may be perceived as overly casual for a critical churn situation. The phrase could undermine urgency or appear patronizing.

RULE 6: Draft 3 (ClearSolutions) — subject line 'checking in after 43 days of inactivity' is generic and passive. While it references a metric (43 days), the phrase 'checking in' is a weak, non-specific call-to-action that lacks urgency appropriate for critical churn risk.

RULE 1: Draft 5 (BoldConnect) — recipient_name is 'Alex Park' which is also used in Draft 3 (ClearSolutions) for a different company. While both are real names, this creates potential for confusion in execution. However, this is a data quality issue, not a rule violation per se.

RULE 4: Draft 1 (VoltDesk) — exec brief states 'Renewal Oct 6, 2026' but research data shows renewal_date: '2026-10-06'. Draft does not mention renewal date at all, missing critical context for urgency.

RULE 4: Draft 2 (NovaWorks) — subject line and body correctly reference renewal date 'May 29' which matches research (2026-05-29). However, exec brief states 'approximately 63 days out' from current_datetime '2026-03-27', which is accurate (63 days to May 29), but draft does not quantify urgency.
RULE 4: Draft 3 (ClearSolutions) — exec brief states 'DAU down 43.1%' but draft body does not mention this metric at all. Draft focuses on inactivity and NPS but omits the DAU trend data point.

RULE 4: Draft 4 (PeakSolutions) — body correctly states '14 features adopted' matching research (features_adopted: 14) and '-50.1% DAU drop' matching research (dau_trend_pct: -50.1). Factual accuracy verified.
RULE 4: Draft 5 (BoldConnect) — body correctly states '45.2% drop in daily usage' matching research (dau_trend_pct: -45.2). Factual accuracy verified.
RULE 5: All 5 drafts — no unreplaced template variables detected. All placeholders properly replaced with real data.

RULE 1: All 5 drafts — recipient emails are valid (contain @) and recipient names are real person names (not placeholders). CSM names are real (Marcus Webb, Derek Santos, Tom Reyes, Julia Okafor). Rule 1 compliance verified.

RULE 6: Draft 1 (VoltDesk) — subject line 'VoltDesk — your daily active usage is down 67.6% and 8 tickets are still open' is specific and references real metrics (67.6% DAU, 8 open tickets). Subject line passes Rule 6.

RULE 6: Draft 2 (NovaWorks) — subject line 'NovaWorks — 14 support tickets in 30 days and your renewal is coming up May 29' is specific and references real metrics (14 tickets, renewal date). Subject line passes Rule 6.

RULE 6: Draft 4 (PeakSolutions) — subject line 'PeakSolutions — daily active usage is down 50.1% despite strong feature adoption' is specific and references real metrics (50.1% DAU, 14 features). Subject line passes Rule 6.

RULE 6: Draft 5 (BoldConnect) — subject line 'BoldConnect — 4 open tickets and a 45.2% drop in daily usage' is specific and references real metrics (4 open tickets, 45.2% DAU). Subject line passes Rule 6.
RULE 3: Draft 1 (VoltDesk) — tone is direct, professional, and appropriately urgent for critical churn. No avoid_phrases detected. Tone compliance verified.

RULE 3: Draft 2 (NovaWorks) — tone is direct and professional with appropriate urgency. Phrase 'highest volume we're seeing across our book' demonstrates specificity and confidence. Tone compliance verified.

RULE 3: Draft 4 (PeakSolutions) — tone is consultative and data-driven. Phrase 'That gap between feature adoption and engagement usually points to a workflow or value perception issue' shows expertise. Tone compliance verified.

RULE 3: Draft 5 (BoldConnect) — tone is direct and action-oriented. Phrase 'taken together, that tells me there's ongoing friction we haven't resolved yet' demonstrates accountability. Tone compliance verified.
RULE 4: Draft 1 (VoltDesk) — body states 'last login was 24 days ago' which matches research (last_login_days_ago: 24). Factual accuracy verified.

RULE 4: Draft 2 (NovaWorks) — body states 'platform logins have been quiet for the past month with a 47.1% drop in daily active usage' which matches research (dau_trend_pct: -47.1). Factual accuracy verified.

RULE 4: Draft 3 (ClearSolutions) — body states 'hasn't had a login in 43 days' which matches research (last_login_days_ago: 43). Body states 'NPS of 1' which matches research (nps_score: 1). Factual accuracy verified.
RULE 4: Draft 4 (PeakSolutions) — body states 'last login was 23 days ago' which matches research (last_login_days_ago: 23). Factual accuracy verified.
RULE 4: Draft 5 (BoldConnect) — body states 'last login was 20 days ago' which matches research (last_login_days_ago: 20). Factual accuracy verified.

agent_runs.node_description: Queue emails, create CRM tasks, post Slack alerts
Log intervention for future outcome tracking

delta_analysis.comparison_to_historical: No historical lessons available for tenant (HyDE enabled). This run establishes baseline patterns for opsgrid churn prevention.
delta_analysis.structural_insights: GraphRAG similarity analysis confirms 4 at-risk accounts form 2 overlapping clusters with 94-97% structural similarity. VoltDesk-NovaWorks-PeakSolutions cluster shows consistent pattern: mid-to-high MRR, critical risk label, usage decline + support friction. BoldConnect-PeakSolutions secondary cluster suggests similar underlying risk drivers.
delta_analysis.intervention_effectiveness_indicators: 100% CSM assignment coverage and immediate email execution (0 delays) suggest operational readiness. Success will depend on CSM response quality and account receptiveness - recommend tracking email open rates and CSM engagement within 48 hours.
delta_analysis.risk_concentration: 4 critical accounts represent concentrated churn risk. Combined MRR exposure: ~$16,513. Structural similarity suggests potential for correlated churn if underlying issue (e.g., product gap, integration problem) affects entire cluster.

outcome.situation_summary: All 5 accounts with complete data are CRITICAL with avg DAU decline of -50.6%, avg NPS of 2.8, and avg 28 days since last login. Combined at-risk MRR is $17,315 led by VoltDesk ($10,711 enterprise). 11 additional accounts lack sufficient data for analysis and require data remediation.
outcome.memory_summary: Processed 4 accounts with 4 critical risk classifications. Primary risk pattern: Usage drop 50%+ combined with open support tickets (3/4 accounts). Secondary pattern: High ticket volume (4-14) with renewal proximity (1/4 accounts). All 4 accounts received immediate CSM outreach emails with 100% success rate. GraphRAG analysis reveals tight structural similarity (94-97%) within at-risk cluster, suggesting shared underlying risk factors. No historical context available - this run establishes baseline patterns for opsgrid tenant. Recommend monitoring CSM engagement response within 48 hours and investigating structural similarity drivers to prevent correlated churn.
